**Goal** — one or two sentences.

**Owned paths** — the files/crates this task may change. Nothing else.

**Done when** — the observable result: a test, a command, a behaviour.

**Do not touch** — anything nearby that is off-limits.

**Depends on** — issue numbers, if any.
